page.overview:
What is White Sand Volume 3?

White Sand Volume 3 is the third and final graphic novel of the serthumbies White Sand. White Sand is set on the Dayside of the Shardworld Taldain. It is an adaptation of one of the novels Brandon wrote prior to being published. The script was adapted from prose form to graphic novel form by Rik Hoskin. After the artist change at the end of volume 2, Fritz Casas was selected as the artist for volume 3. Coloring was done by Salvatore Aiala Studios, lettering was done by DC Hopkins, and editing was done by Joseph Rybandt.
